metadata.question: Were Shebelle River's levels higher on May 9, 2018 in comparison to May 17,2015?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use a single water index image for each date (NDWI or MNDWI), take the mean over the Shebelle channel, and compare. - Collection: Sentinel-2 SR (COPERNICUS/S2_SR) – 10 m, reliable 2015-2018. - Location: A ~80 km reach of the Shebelle River in southern Somalia (agricultural lowlands). - Dates: 2018-05-09 vs 2015-05-17, each ±1 week to guarantee cloud-free scenes. 2. Masking: Apply QA60 cloud mask (bits 10 and 11) and keep pixels with valid data. Compute MNDWI = (Green – SWIR1)/(Green + SWIR1). Band names: ‘B3’ = Green, ‘B11’ = SWIR1. 3. Logic: - If either collection is empty → C1. - After compositing & masking, if valid-pixel count = 0 → C2. - If computed mean MNDWI is None/NaN → C3. - Otherwise: higher on 2018-05-09 → A, else B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry – main Shebelle channel, southern Somalia shebelle = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([42.8, 0.2, 44.2, 1.4]) # 80 km reach # 2. Acquire Sentinel-2 SR def get_mndwi(year, month, day): start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, month, day).advance(-7, 'day') end = start.advance(14, 'day') s2 = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(shebelle) .filterDate(start, end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 40))) if s2.size().getInfo() == 0: return None, 0 img = (s2.map(lambda i: i.updateMask(i.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(0x1800).eq(0))) .map(lambda i: i.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('mndwi')) .median()) count = img.select('mndwi').reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=shebelle, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('mndwi').getInfo() mean = img.select('mndwi').reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=shebelle, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('mndwi').getInfo() return mean, count mndwi15, c15 = get_mndwi(2015, 5, 17) mndwi18, c18 = get_mndwi(2018, 5, 9) if mndwi15 is None or mndwi18 is None: print("Empty collection for one date.") print("C1") elif c15 == 0 or c18 == 0: print("No valid pixels after masking.") print("C2") elif mndwi15 is None or mndwi18 is None: print("Calculation failed.") print("C3") else: print(f"2015 MNDWI: {mndwi15:.3f} (pixels: {c15})") print(f"2018 MNDWI: {mndwi18:.3f} (pixels: {c18})") print("A" if mndwi18 > mndwi15 else "B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry – main Shebelle channel, southern Somalia
shebelle = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([42.8, 0.2, 44.2, 1.4])  # 80 km reach

# 2. Acquire Sentinel-2 SR
def get_mndwi(year, month, day):
    start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, month, day).advance(-7, 'day')
    end   = start.advance(14, 'day')
    s2 = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')
          .filterBounds(shebelle)
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 40)))
    if s2.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None, 0
    img = (s2.map(lambda i: i.updateMask(i.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(0x1800).eq(0)))
          .map(lambda i: i.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('mndwi'))
          .median())
    count = img.select('mndwi').reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=shebelle, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('mndwi').getInfo()
    mean = img.select('mndwi').reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=shebelle, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('mndwi').getInfo()
    return mean, count

mndwi15, c15 = get_mndwi(2015, 5, 17)
mndwi18, c18 = get_mndwi(2018, 5, 9)

if mndwi15 is None or mndwi18 is None:
    print("Empty collection for one date.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif c15 == 0 or c18 == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif mndwi15 is None or mndwi18 is None:
    print("Calculation failed.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print(f"2015 MNDWI: {mndwi15:.3f} (pixels: {c15})")
    print(f"2018 MNDWI: {mndwi18:.3f} (pixels: {c18})")
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if mndwi18 > mndwi15 else "<answer>B</answer>")
